## Files created

**Source (all new, zero dependencies, CommonJS):**

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `src/config.js` | `~/.memo/config.json` per §6.4: defaults, sanitizing of hand-edits, `set` with type coercion/range checks, price table (§10.1), API-key lookup via `apiKeyEnv` → `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`/`OPENAI_API_KEY` fallback, `maskKey` so the key only ever prints as `set (…last4)` |
| `src/usage.js` | `chars/4` token estimate, per-call cost, `~/.memo/logs/usage.jsonl` line `{ts,repoId,job,model,in,out,costEst}`, monthly totals (reads the rotated `.1` file too), budget state |
| `src/store/records.js` | `.memory/records/{decisions,errors,learnings,facts,tasks,questions,intent}.jsonl` op-log: type/status tables, `makeId` (prefix + 8 hex of sha1(type+normalized statement+first evidence)), fold by id (last op wins, `delete` removes), `openRecords` (non-terminal, newest 60), `byId`, `hasJob`, fsynced append |
| `src/llm/provider.js` | interface + factory, `ProviderError{kind: retryable\|auth\|bad_request\|quota}`, 3 attempts with 2 s/8 s/30 s backoff honouring `retry-after`, 60 s `AbortController`, status→kind mapping, quota detection; logs only status/kind/attempt/requestId |
| `src/llm/anthropic.js` | `POST /v1/messages`, `x-api-key` + `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`, joins **all** text blocks (current models emit an empty thinking block first), maps `usage.input_tokens/output_tokens`, treats `stop_reason: refusal` as non-retryable |
| `src/llm/openai.js` | `POST /v1/chat/completions` with `response_format: {type:'json_object'}`, `Bearer` auth, `max_completion_tokens`, maps `prompt_tokens/completion_tokens` |
| `src/llm/mock.js` | replays `test/fixtures/llm/*.json` by key via `MEMO_MOCK_LLM`; built-in steps `429/500/timeout/auth/quota/bad_request/empty`; same retry wrapper, zero waiting |
| `src/extract/prompt.js` | fixed system rules (§6.3), user payload `{repo, open_records, events}`, token-capped batching in `seq` order, repair-prompt builder, **second redaction stage** + drops events naming denylisted paths; sends only `id,seq,ts,type,tool,text,ok,truncated` |
| `src/extract/validate.js` | all eight §6.3 rules in code: enum enforcement, 500-char strings, ≤25 items, unknown fields dropped, evidence must exist in batch or records, `update.id` must exist with matching type, `intent` needs `user_prompt` evidence, file-path sanitizing, and the **downgrade** of `verified`/`done` → `resolved_unverified`/`implemented_unverified` + `downgraded:true` unless an evidence `tool_result` has `ok:true`; `auto_exec` forced to `false` |
| `src/extract/process.js` | the orchestrator: job id `j-`+10 hex of `sha1(sid:from:to)`, job-already-applied recovery, budget/`apiEnabled`/`paused` gates, call cap, one repair call then `failed_permanent`, retry accounting to `failed_retryable` after 5, record append, summary, `processedThrough` advanced **last**, per-repo `process.lock` |

- **Phase 1 inspect kiya** — pura implemented mila (capture, sessions store, repos, lock, log, redact). Phase 2 bilkul absent tha (grep se confirm).

  - `src/llm/provider.js`, `anthropic.js`, `openai.js`, `mock.js`

  - `src/report/session-summary.js`, `scripts/try-extract.js`
